items.title: Saudi's trillion-dollar plans were crashing into financial reality — then came the Iran war
items.description: Saudi Arabia's plans to transform its economy were already facing headwinds when the Iran war broke out, placing them even further in jeopardy.

items.title: Live: Iran blames US for failed peace talks during visit to Russia
items.description: Iran's foreign minister says the US's "excessive demands" were the cause of failed peace talks. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has discussed the latest Iranian proposal. Follow live.

items.title: 'Deeply concerning': New report questions if UK can keep AUKUS promises
items.description: The House of Commons Defence Committee releases the findings of its year-long review into the trilateral defence partnership.

items.title: Live: King Charles and Queen Camilla arrive in US as shooting suspect charged with attempted assassination of Trump
items.description: Cole Tomas Allen, 31, is expected to face firearm and assault charges. Follow live.

items.title: Such frequent attacks on a president 'unusual' in US history
items.description: The latest attack on US President Donald Trump has once again thrust his country's long history of political violence into the spotlight.

items.title: AI architects become their own victims
items.description: Tim Cook helped usher in a communications revolution and his departure from Apple marks a turning point for the company. It also serves as a reminder of how AI is changing the tech landscape.

items.title: Live: Former Republican congressman nominated as US ambassador to Australia
items.description: David Brat, who unseated a Democratic house majority leader, has been named as the Trump administration's pick for the Canberra posting. Follow live.

items.title: Taylor's $800m pitch to double fuel reserves to come at a cost to drives
items.description: Australia would have 60 days' worth of fuel supplies in reserve under an $800 million Coalition proposal that would cost drivers one cent per litre.

items.title: One of Australia's tropical islands now costs twice as much to run
items.description: Fuel costs have more than doubled for one of the Great Barrier Reef's major tourism operators — and it's forcing a rethink on how paradise is powered.

items.title: Diabetics pay thousands of dollars a year for drug still not on the PBS
items.description: The "broken" process behind listing medication on the PBS has contributed to hundreds of thousands of Australians with diabetes missing out on subsidised lifesaving medication, according to the peak industry body.

items.title: Indigenous players defend Lyon after comment at training led to 'emotional' meeting
items.description: Several indigenous players who have played under Saints coach Ross Lyon come to his defence after comments he made during a training session led to a meeting where Lyon offered to stand down.

items.title: They were the first victims of the Port Arthur massacre. Their family has never forgotten
items.description: Seascape guesthouse owners Sally and David Martin were the first people murdered at Port Arthur in 1996. On the 30th anniversary of the tragedy, their granddaughter tells of how the family has refused to be defined by it.

items.title: This basket isn't real, but it might affect your mortgage repayments
items.description: There are some key moments coming up for the Australian economy and they could make a big difference to your bank account. Emily Stewart — aka Sensible Emily — is here to help you understand what to look out for.

items.title: Live: Wall Street hits records as Australia awaits inflation data
items.description: Two of the key US indices are at record highs despite uncertainty about the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: The moment Andy Lee feared exploits with Hamish Blake had gone too far
items.description: Andy Lee opens up on his 23-year working relationship with his "fast and loose" comedy partner Hamish Blake, and the stunt that left him fearing for his mate's life.

items.title: The best ways to prevent common credit and debit card fraud
items.description: Experts reveal the most common ways fraudsters steal card details and how to keep your accounts safer.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world are we?
items.description: Today's ABC Places quiz features photos from 10 locations around the world. Your challenge is to guess where you are.

items.title: Farmer rescues kangaroo from muddy dam amid 'perilous' drought conditions
items.description: Photos show a kangaroo moments before being rescued from a bone-dry dam in Central West NSW, after it became bogged while searching for water in an increasingly barren landscape.

items.title: Penny Wong confronts the limits of Australia's China strategy
items.description: When Foreign Minister Penny Wong travels to Japan, China and South Korea this week, she will move through a region where relationships point in different directions at the same time.

items.title: Search for missing 5yo enters third day as helicopters, heat drones deployed
items.description: Helicopters, heat sensor drones and dozens of people combing through thick scrubland have joined the increasingly desperate search for Sharon Granites.

items.title: Bupa patients lose out on choice and risk out-of-pockets under No Gap scheme, experts warn
items.description: Leaked contracts obtained by the ABC reveal Bupa's deals with private hospitals impose stifling conditions on operators that are too small to push back.

items.title: Academic says she watches everything she eats because of overseas threats
items.description: Iranian Australian journalist and academic Saba Vasefi has spent years documenting human rights abuses in her homeland. The regime she's criticised has not forgotten her name.

items.title: Two Marios behind a Melbourne institution celebrate its 40th birthday
items.description: It may have once denied Jerry Seinfield a booking, but this Fitzroy cafe has won no shortage of fans during its four decades.

items.title: Community divided over $1.5b waste-to-energy incinerator proposal
items.description: A proposed waste-to-energy incinerator near Beaudesert divides the Scenic Rim community. Supporters say it could ease Queensland's landfill crisis, while opponents fear health and environmental risks.

items.title: Doctors fear new hospital design has 'increased risk of death' for women
items.description: Doctors say parts of the proposed design for Adelaide's $3.2 billion new Women's and Children's Hospital raise "significant concerns", including the location of the women's assessment service.
